back_cover_blurb: Build apps that look and feel world-class.

This book shows you how to direct an AI coding assistant to build professional mobile apps for Android and iOS: the kind with instant steppers, live order tracking, story viewers and spotless checkout flows that users expect from the best apps in the world.

You will build four complete apps from one design system and one backend, a food delivery app, an online store, a social photo app and a 10-minute grocery app, plus a bonus streaming app for Android TV. Every app was built by real, recorded Claude Code sessions, and every screen in this full-color book is a real capture.
- Directing Claude Code like a tech lead
- Expo, React Native and a shared design system
- Live tracking, carts, payments and returns
- Push, deep links, security and privacy
- Shipping to Google Play and the App Store
- Bonus: Android TV, focus and the D-pad
